code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_parts = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i+1] > row_bounds[i]+1]
    col_parts = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i+1] > col_bounds[i]+1]
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r0,r1 in row_parts for c0,c1 in col_parts for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
    background = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    source = max(((sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)), r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in row_parts for c0,c1 in col_parts), default=(0,0,0,0,0))
    _, sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1 = source
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in row_parts:
        for c0,c1 in col_parts:
            if (r0,r1,c0,c1) == (sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1):
                continue
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+dc]
    return out
'''
